summary: Frontend-only mobile web testing completed for Phase 1 routes. Settings row routing mostly works, but a critical red-screen crash exists on /chats due to web-incompatible notifications API usage.

ui_bugs.component: ComingSoon icon on App Lock screen
ui_bugs.issue: Invalid Ionicons name "lock-outline" logs warning and icon does not render correctly.

integration_issues.issue: React Native red error overlay appears: ExpoNotifications.getLastNotificationResponse is not available on web (from usePushNotifications hook). This blocks testing AI Assistant and Emergency via chats-tab buttons.
Switch renders and remains stable, but updateProfile mutation returns Convex server error in current unauthenticated/public test context.

react_native_issues.component: Tabs push notification integration on web
react_native_issues.issue: Web runtime calls Notifications.getLastNotificationResponseAsync() unguarded; unsupported API triggers red screen.

action_items: Guard push-notification APIs for Platform.OS === 'web' in usePushNotifications, especially getLastNotificationResponseAsync and response listener setup.
Retest /chats tab after web guard fix, then re-verify chat-ai, chat-once, and sos-button tap navigation.
Fix App Lock placeholder icon name (use a valid Ionicons or MaterialCommunityIcons name).
Verify notification switch mutations under authenticated session if backend requires auth context.
critical_code_review_comments: Critical: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx always mounts usePushNotifications(), but src/push/usePushNotifications.ts calls web-unsupported Expo Notifications API without web guard.
Fallback query wrapper works as intended on Earnings/Blocked/Emergency/AI routes: missing/errored optional Convex endpoints degrade to UI state instead of Convex overlay.
Some runtime warnings remain (deprecated shadow* props, pointerEvents prop warning) and should be cleaned up to reduce noise during QA.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test credentials file exists at /app/memory/test_credentials.md. /app/auth_testing.md and /app/auth-testing.md are missing. Settings route is directly testable; tabs route currently crashes on web due push hook.
rca_of_issue: Repro: open https://smilers-chat-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com/chats. Result: red overlay 'ExpoNotifications.getLastNotificationResponse is not available on web' at src/push/usePushNotifications.ts line ~175. Root cause: tabs layout mounts push hook on web and hook unconditionally calls native notification response API. Mitigation: add web guard around unsupported notifications APIs and register listeners only on supported platforms.
